verdict: Spend up, purchases growing, but weekly return rate needs steadying.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 35 purchases on $1,482.96 in spend, producing a 4.48x return on ad spend. This past week, spend rose 33.88% and purchases climbed 16.67%, but daily revenue is running unevenly — one day can produce $450 in sales while the next produces zero — which is compressing the weekly return figure without signaling a real trend reversal. The 28-day number remains the reliable read right now. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this week and has shown no recorded actions for three consecutive days; we're investigating whether this is a listing or data feed issue rather than a drop in customer interest. Five project milestones from August are being reviewed and resolved this week so the broader roadmap stays on schedule toward the September 30 targets.
